thread:
leah_sales: Heads up - MeridianCo returned our RFI and security questionnaire. They want a Private VPC POC, committed monthly price bands, and a filled capability matrix. Dropping the draft RFI here. Need SOC2 snippets and confirmation on audit log retention.

tony_se: For POC they requested customer-managed peering. We can provide VPC-lite with ephemeral storage and 30-day audit logs. HSM available but needs approvals.

nina_solutions: I'll update the capability matrix CSV and RFI answers. Quick Q: should pricing list CPU-fallback as an option? Customers ask about cost vs latency tradeoffs.

dev_aj: Yes, include a footnote: "CPU fallback may be used when GPU capacity is constrained; estimated -18% cost, higher tail latency." Also recommend modeling costs with quantized-standard-2.

ops_bot: Security template applied: encryption_at_rest and key_rotation answers inserted. Reminder to upload /attachments/audit_policy_poc.pdf.

leah_sales: Draft pricing for review: Dedicated-4GPU:$20,000/mo + POC $12k; Dedicated-8GPU:$37,000/mo + POC $12k; Private-VPC-Small:$24,000/mo + POC $14k.

tony_se: Those look fine. Add note: "POC pricing assumes 30-day eval, no production SLA."

nina_solutions: I'll add graceful-degradation wording and routing policy examples to the RFI. Will attach updated PDF once done.

leah_sales: Customer proposes kickoff week Apr 20. Can we hit that? Need infra signoff and calendar invites.

dev_aj: Apr 20 tight. Recommend Apr 27. I can assemble infra checklist and timeline this week.

leah_sales: OK, aim for Apr 27. Please confirm when updated RFI PDF and audit policy are in attachments so I can upload to their portal.
